The console has a visible 'PS4' logo on the front right side.

The console is placed on a wooden surface.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, power, cooling)
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game or disc.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have dead buttons/axes
risks.proof: Video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to inputs.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a video showing the console's system settings screen.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., power cable, HDMI cable, or game discs)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out clearly.

Video showing both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Photo of the console's system settings screen showing model and serial number.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
